description: This file contains type hints for verbose-related functions in the PyTorch C++ extension backend, specifically for enabling verbose output for MKL and MKLDNN components.

methods.name: mkl_set_verbose
methods.description: Sets the verbosity level for MKL library messages.

parameters.enable: Integer flag to enable (non-zero) or disable (zero) verbosity.

methods.name: mkldnn_set_verbose
methods.description: Sets the verbosity level for MKLDNN (oneDNN) library messages.
